children: Japanese stocks may rise following U.S. stock gains overnight as concerns about borrowing costs ease. Nikkei futures are up 0.1% at 70940 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.25 yen, compared with Y158.18 as of Tuesday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on developments in the Iran conflict, crude oil prices and bond yields. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 1.1% to 70683.98 on Tuesday, closing above the 70000 threshold for the first time since July 1. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
